title: Retained slotless review and expiry
description: Opt-in: consumes two real Codex turns. Set FARMSLOT_REVIEW_RETENTION_PROOF_OUTPUT to a private evidence directory. Creates an isolated farm and tiny Git source, runs two genuine reviews, reads results through authenticated Gateway RPC, verifies exact-session continuation, then clock-controlled expiry and pending-review protection. No live farm, publication or slot action.

two-rounds.intent: Two genuine completed reviews share the exact retained conversation while the second checks only the new Git delta.

expiry.intent: Pending review protects retained files, expiry reports cold fallback, and authenticated run.cleanup reclaims the custom-root support cache, and run records/report bytes survive before fixture teardown.
